note: OpenSanctions maritime: ships and shipping organisations on sanctions, detention and risk lists.
title: OpenSanctions maritime risk list
description: Each row of OpenSanctions' maritime export is one listing: a vessel (identified by IMO number) or an organisation, with the risk tags and source datasets OpenSanctions assigns (sanction, shadow fleet, port-state detention, ...). A listing is an event dated from the first day the feeder saw it; when OpenSanctions changes its tags, the API stores a new version, so a rewind shows the tags as they stood.
